items.docs: Returns a paginated list of documents accessible to the authenticated user. Supports filtering by template, form, folder, contact, status, tag, owner, and date ranges. Results can be ordered by various fields.

Creates a new document from a template, an uploaded file, or a URL. The document is created in draft status and can be customized with recipient details, field values, pricing table data, and metadata tokens before being sent for signature.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the document.

items.docs: Retrieves comprehensive details for a specific document including its status, recipients, fields, pricing tables, tokens, tags, and metadata.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the document.

items.docs: Permanently deletes a specific document by its identifier. This action is irreversible and removes the document and all associated data.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the document.

items.docs: Returns the current status of a document. Use this endpoint to poll for status transitions after creating or sending a document.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the document.

items.docs: Sends a document in draft status to its recipients for e-signature collection or review. Optionally includes a subject line, custom message, and controls whether email notifications are sent silently. The document must be in document.draft status before it can be sent.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the document.

params.name: watermark_color
params.description: Hex color code for watermark text applied to the downloaded PDF.

params.name: watermark_font_size
params.description: Font size for watermark text in points.

params.name: watermark_opacity
params.description: Opacity of the watermark from 0.0 to 1.0.

params.name: watermark_text
params.description: Text to render as a watermark on every page of the PDF.

params.name: separate_files
params.description: If true, returns a ZIP archive containing each document section as a separate PDF file.

items.docs: Downloads the signed PDF for a completed document. The document must be in document.completed status. Returns the binary PDF file content with appropriate Content-Disposition headers.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the document.

items.docs: Creates a time-limited session token for embedded document viewing or signing. The returned session ID is used to embed the PandaDoc document viewer within an iframe in the host application. Session lifetime and recipient scope are configurable.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the document.

items.docs: Returns the list of recipients associated with a document, including their roles, completion status, signing order, and contact information.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the document.

items.docs: Adds a new recipient to a document that is in draft status. Recipients can be assigned roles that map to signature and form fields within the document. The recipient will receive signing instructions when the document is sent.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the document.

params.name: recipient_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the document recipient.

items.docs: Updates the details of an existing recipient on a document, such as their name, email, role, or signing order. The document must be in an editable state.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the document.

params.name: recipient_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the document recipient.

items.docs: Removes a recipient from a document. The document must not have been sent yet. If the recipient has associated fields, those fields will be unassigned.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the document.

items.docs: Returns all fields defined in a document, including their identifiers, types, values, roles, and positions. Supports filtering by field type and recipient role.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the document.

items.docs: Updates the values of one or more fields in a document that is in draft status. Supports updating text fields, checkboxes, dropdowns, dates, and other field types by name.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the document.

items.docs: Returns a list of all file attachments associated with a document. Includes attachment metadata such as name, size, and upload date.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the document.

params.name: attachment_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the document attachment.

items.docs: Downloads a specific attachment file associated with a document. Returns the binary file content with appropriate content type headers.

params.name: document_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the document.

items.docs: Retrieves the automatic reminder configuration for a specific document, including the schedule and message used for outstanding recipient notification emails.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of contacts from the workspace contacts directory. Supports search by name, email, or company. Contacts can be used to pre-populate recipient data when creating documents.
Creates a new contact record in the workspace contacts directory. The email field is optional. Contacts can be referenced when adding recipients to documents.

params.description: Unique identifier of the contact.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the contact.

items.docs: Permanently removes a contact from the workspace contacts directory. Documents and templates that previously used this contact are not affected.
Returns a list of all members in the current workspace, including their user details, roles, and status. Useful for workspace administration and for looking up member identifiers.
Returns the profile of the currently authenticated member, including their identifier, email, name, role, and workspace association.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the workspace member.

items.docs: Retrieves the details of a specific workspace member by their unique identifier, including their name, email, role, and membership status.
Returns a paginated list of all webhook subscriptions configured in the workspace, including their trigger types, target URLs, payload options, and current status.

Creates a new webhook subscription that will deliver event notifications to the specified URL. Specify the trigger event types and optional payload extras (fields, products, metadata, tokens, pricing) to include in each notification.

params.name: id
params.description: UUID of the webhook subscription.

params.name: id
params.description: UUID of the webhook subscription.

params.name: id
params.description: UUID of the webhook subscription.

items.docs: Permanently deletes a webhook subscription. No further notifications will be delivered to the associated URL after deletion.

params.name: id
params.description: UUID of the webhook subscription.
